storage.immutability: source run, document, and bundle artifacts are never overwritten; index and latest are rebuildable derived views
storage.writerAuthority: writer-context-v1 must reference an immutable bundle gzip; latest is never authoritative writer input
storage.p1gaArtifacts: P1-GA creates no index, latest view, production bundle, or gzip data artifact

rules: itemCount is an integer greater than or equal to zero
ready, partial, and stale require a lowercase 64-character SHA-256 rawSnapshotId and stored or hash_only snapshotPolicy
unavailable, rate_limited, and schema_changed require rawSnapshotId null, snapshotPolicy none, coverage.itemCount 0, and at least one warning
requestedAt is audit time and is excluded from business identity
asOf is an ISO timestamp or null and must never be fabricated from the current time
sourceId references a source run in the bundle
canonicalUrl is HTTPS and is not a Google, Bing, or other search-results URL
contentSha256 and rawSnapshotId are lowercase 64-character SHA-256 values
publishedAt may be null but accessedAt must not be substituted for it
metadata and bounded evidence excerpts only; full text, HTML, base64, and binary content are prohibited
window contains start, end, and Asia/Shanghai timezone; end equals asOf and start is not later than end
sourceRuns, documents, observations, events, and duplicateClusters sort by their identity field
observations have at least one supports basis, reference existing documents, have nonempty marketScopes and topics, and do not add probability, ranking, or investment advice
occurredAt and observation asOf are not later than bundle asOf
events only organize existing observations and add no new facts, probability, forecast, or importance score
duplicate cluster members exist, number at least two, include canonicalDocumentId, and a document belongs to at most one cluster
exact-url clusters require equal canonicalUrl; content-hash clusters require equal contentSha256; publisher-reprint and semantic-signature retain every source audit record
daily and weekly coverage include A_SHARE, HK, US, and FED; GLOBAL is supplemental only
coverage counts exactly equal arrays; unavailable has nonempty reasons; partial states explain gaps; zero is an actual count rather than availability
bundleId equals integrity.businessSha256; the same bundleId with different content fails closed; generatedAt is audit time and is excluded from bundle identity
stored is only for permitted official structured or publicly redistributable material
hash_only is the default for media, community, social, and copyright-unclear pages
none is required for unavailable, rate_limited, schema_changed, or explicitly prohibited sources

identity.hash: SHA-256 of canonicalized business content using deterministic ordering
identity.conflictBehavior: same identity and same content is idempotent; same identity and different content fails closed

precedence: without contradicts, a supports basis from official-primary, company-filing, exchange-market-data, or primary-research produces confirmed
without an authoritative primary source, supports from at least two distinct publishers produce corroborated
supports solely from community-signal or social-signal produce unverified
all other single-publisher support produces single-source
constraints: different URLs from the same publisher are not independent corroboration
community-signal and social-signal never produce confirmed or corroborated
AI must not assign an evidenceState inconsistent with this derivation

hashOnlyRetains: response status and collection audit metadata
noneRequired: source explicitly prohibited from collection or storage
prohibited: bulk retention of news full text
media image, video, or PDF binary download or embedding

writerContextBoundary.p1fTransition: writer-request-v1 will be upgraded or replaced in P1-H; P1-GA does not modify P1-F code
